messages:
hiro: FYI we're planning a phased catalog enable for comet-3b-v3 during the 21:00-22:30 PT change window tomorrow. Proposal: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. Seeking signoff on fallback ordering and rollback gates.

carmen: thumbs up on timing. What does the fallback ladder look like? We should prefer variants that maintain kv cache compatibility.

hiro: fallback ladder proposed: 1) comet-3b-v3-quant (primary) 2) comet-3b-v3-fp16 (same weights) 3) comet-3b-legacy-3b. Note: v3 changes tokenizer slightly; we'll enable tokenizer compatibility shim in front to avoid client breaks.

sre: Oncall will be available. Suggest regional fallback rule: if a region's p95 > baseline + 90ms for 8m, move that region to next fallback automatically and alert.

product: Add a customer-impact check: if top-10 active customers see more than 2% error delta we pause and notify CS.

qa-bot: qa-bot: Preflight QA runpassed (sample vectors 500 items), quality delta median -0.3% BLEU. Full report: https://qa.internal/comet3b-v3/report. Seedset used: /evals/comet3b/seedset-v3.jsonl

hiro: Good. Rollback/stop gates I propose: p95 latency +120ms sustained 10m -> auto-pause; error rate >1% 5m -> immediate unpin; quality drop >4% on seedset -> pause and manual review; token-cost delta +35% -> auto-pause. Also autoscaler failure (can't add nodes in 7m) -> rollback.

carmen: Agree. Also add an OOM threshold: if OOMs >0.15% across replicas for 3m, switch to fp16 in that region.

hiro: Adding that. Will include explicit commands in the runbook:

# pin to staged percent
curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/v1/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"comet-3b-v3","percent":3,"reason":"staged-enable-1733339001"}'

# emergency unpin
curl -X POST "https://catalog.redwood.internal/v1/unpin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"comet-3b-v3","reason":"emergency-rollback"}'

hiro: deploybot, please queue and run checksum compatibility and tokenizer-shim smoke tests before the 1% stage.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks queued and passed: checksum ok, quota ok, tokenizer-shim smoke OK. Enable scheduled at 2024-07-15T21:00:00-07:00. Stages: 0.5%, 3%, 15%, 40%, 100%. Canary window: 10m per stage. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/comet3b-cutover. Use `deploybot watch 1733339001`.

sre: I'll be onpager. For visibility, I'll publish p95/p50/error-rate snapshots at each stage to the thread and to #eng-sre-dashboard.

product: Please add short blurbs for release notes: 1) "Comet 3B v3: faster multi-turn context handling" 2) "Tokenizer shim will be used to preserve client compatibility". I'll distribute to CS.

carmen: One operational note: warm KV cache for 6m after the 15% stage. Script: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --model comet-3b-v3 --duration 6m --sample 0.15`

hiro: Added. Final checklist: preflight pass, QA pass, SRE oncall, deploybot queued, product blurb ready. Proceed with scheduled rollout. If any gate trips, oncall (sre) executes unpin and posts updates.

qa-bot: qa-bot: attaching quick compare graphs: https://qa.internal/comet3b-v3/compare. Seedset artifacts uploaded.

sre: I'll monitor autoscaler and queue depth. If queue depth increases > 30% for 2 consecutive samples, we pause the next stage and escalate.

carmen: Thanks all. I'll post a tiny release note at 3% and include the runbook link. ping me @carmen when the first stage starts.

hiro: Thanks team. Good luck. Remember to tag this thread when any stage moves."
